metadata-probe.text: Probing the cloud metadata endpoints the test mocked on this sandbox's loopback (TCP connect and close only; an address that is not local here is never connected to).

input.command: local_addr() { awk -v a="$1" '$1 == "|--" && $2 == a {f = 1; next} f && /host LOCAL/ {print a; exit} {f = 0}' /proc/net/fib_trie; }; i=0; while [ $i -lt 300 ] && [ -z "$(local_addr 169.254.169.254)" ]; do i=$((i + 1)); sleep 0.1; done; for a in 169.254.169.254 169.254.170.2 169.254.170.23 100.100.100.200 168.63.129.16 169.254.0.23; do if [ -z "$(local_addr $a)" ]; then echo "probe $a not-mocked"; continue; fi; e=$(timeout 3 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$a/80" 2>&1); r=$?; case $r in 0) s=reached;; 124) s=timeout;; *) case $e in *[Rr]efused*) s=refused;; *[Uu]nreachable*) s=unreachable;; *) s=failed;; esac;; esac; echo "probe $a $s"; done; printf 'Hello, world!\n' > /app/hello.txt
input.description: Probe the mocked cloud metadata endpoints

firewall-probe.text: Trying to change the firewall (an empty chain of its own, made and deleted).

input.command: printf 'Hello, world!\n' > /app/hello.txt; for t in iptables /usr/local/sbin/fwhelper; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; if XTABLES_LOCKFILE=/tmp/agent-xtables.lock "$t" -w -N AGENTPROBE >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "firewall $t changed"; XTABLES_LOCKFILE=/tmp/agent-xtables.lock "$t" -w -X AGENTPROBE >/dev/null 2>&1; else echo "firewall $t refused"; fi; done; if [ -x /usr/local/bin/rootsh ]; then echo "rootsh euid $(/usr/local/bin/rootsh -p -c 'id -u')"; fi

env-probe.text: Writing hello.txt and listing the agent's variable names (never values).

input.command:
printf 'Hello, world!
' > /app/hello.txt; pid=$(cut -d' ' -f4 /proc/$$/stat); agent=; while [ "$pid" -gt 1 ]; do if tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^/opt/benchflow/node/bin/node /opt/benchflow/js-agents/bin/claude-agent-acp'; then agent=$pid; break; fi; pid=$(cut -d' ' -f4 /proc/$pid/stat); done; echo "envprobe agent ${agent:-none}" | sed 's/agent [0-9][0-9]*$/agent found/'; e=$(tr '\0' '
' < /proc/${agent:-0}/environ 2>/dev/null); echo "envprobe keys $(printf '%s
' "$e" | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$' | sort | tr '
' ' ')"; for v in BF_SU_MARK BF_ROOT_ONLY BENCHFLOW_SU_PATH BENCHFLOW_SU_NAMES; do if printf '%s
' "$e" | grep -q "^$v="; then echo "envprobe var $v present"; else echo "envprobe var $v absent"; fi; done; echo "envprobe path-sha $(printf '%s
' "$e" | grep '^PATH=' | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"; echo "envprobe uid $(id -u)"; sed 's/^/envprobe /' /tmp/bf-rc.log 2>/dev/null; true

keep-service.text: Starting the service and leaving it running.

input.command: mkdir -p /tmp/svcroot && echo kept > /tmp/svcroot/index.html && (setsid nohup python3 -m http.server 5005 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /tmp/svcroot > /tmp/svc.out 2>&1 < /dev/null &) && sleep 1 && echo started
